text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — Platinum account 'Mosaic' asked for an exec readout next Wed (10 AM PT). Need slide owners and a short runbook.
Maria Lopez: Ack. Do we have a health summary + onboarding status slide?
Jamal Reed: I can take onboarding status. Short bullets: 75% complete, API keys issued, 2 integration blockers (schema mismatch + rate limits).
Alex Chen: Perfect. Maria — can you own health + renewal signal? include usage trend graph + NPS comment.
Maria Lopez: On it. Draft metric callouts: DAU up 20% month-over-month, but top 3 flows see 40% latency regressions last week. Renewal risk = medium-high unless latency plan shown.
Katie Nguyen: I'll own the action items slide and can run the dry-run. Also can capture feedback items live.
Alex Chen: Who can add a short technical mitigation slide (KV cache + batching plan + ETA)? Jamal you okay?
Jamal Reed: Yup. ETA: rollout across their dedicated pool by Friday + fallback to lower-cost variant if perf spikes. Will add SLO numbers.
Maria Lopez: We should include a one-slide ask for execs: 1) approve two-week priority patch, 2) greenlight limited reserved capacity for Black Friday window. Keep it concise.
Alex Chen: Good. ProductBot: deploy reminder — "Reminder: dry-run session scheduled in #customer-success on Tue 3/21 9:30am PT." :calendar:
Katie Nguyen: I sent the slide template link: https://drive.redwood/example/mosaic-exec-deck (last updated today). Please drop updated slides by Mon EOD.
Jamal Reed: Adding two quick bullets under 'Risks': schema mapping outstanding (owner: Integrations), rate-limit workaround in staging (owner: Infra).
Maria Lopez: I'll prepare the renewal narrative — highlight ARR growth, feature adoption, and show mitigation timeline. Also capture their exec asks from last call: SSO audit + SOC2 evidence.
Alex Chen: For the dry-run: agenda = 1) 10m exec context (Maria), 2) 10m onboarding status (Jamal), 3) 5m mitigation ask (Alex/Jamal), 4) 5m action items + close (Katie). Keep to 30m total.
Katie Nguyen: I'll run the post-dry-run action tracker. Quick format in case helpful:
```
- Owner: name
- Action: short description
- Due: date
- Blockers: if any
```
Alex Chen: Also capture customer feedback rubric — success criteria for this quarter: integration stability, <5% error rate on key flows, and acceptable p99 latency under 1.2s.
Maria Lopez: Noted. I'll add those success criteria to the deck.
Jamal Reed: Do we need an engineering escort on the call? I'd recommend @Samir from infra for Q&A on rate limits.
Alex Chen: Yes please. Samir confirmed via DM he's available for the exec readout.
Katie Nguyen: Final ask — can everyone paste their final slide filenames in thread after upload so I can assemble? Example: "1755551234-onboard-status-jamal.pptx"
Maria Lopez: Uploaded: "Mosaic_health_1755551234_maria.pptx"
Jamal Reed: Uploaded: "Mosaic_onboarding_1755551234_jamal.pptx"
Alex Chen: Uploaded: "Mosaic_exec_ask_1755551234_alex.pptx"
Katie Nguyen: Uploaded assembled deck: "Mosaic_exec_deck_final_1755551234_katie.pptx" — I'll share link in #customer-success and run dry-run Tue 9:30am PT.
ProductBot: action created: "Assemble final deck" assigned to Katie Nguyen, due 1755610000.
Alex Chen: Great work team — let's keep updates short in this thread. If blockers pop, flag ASAP. :thumbsup:
